name: Bakemono
body:
Bakemono are mischievous, metal-eating goblinoids native to the Lands of the Jade Oath. Renowned for their craftwork, sabotage, and ravenous appetite for metal ores and forged blades, the race exhibits striking sexual dimorphism between craft-obsessed males and politically astute females.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits (Male): Male bakemono are tough and clever tinkers, though coarse and disruptive. They gain +2 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, and -2 Charisma.
Ability Score Racial Traits (Female): Female bakemono are intuitive, perceptive, and socially domineering, but physically slight. They gain +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, and -2 Strength.
Type: Humanoid (goblinoid). In campaigns utilizing Jade Oath planar rules, bakemono also count as infernals due to their ancient ancestry.
Size: Small. Bakemono gain a +1 size bonus to AC, a +1 size bonus on attack rolls, a -1 penalty to CMB and CMD, and a +4 size bonus on Stealth checks.
Base Speed: Slow. Bakemono have a base land speed of 20 feet.
Languages: Bakemono begin play speaking Common and Goblin. Bonus languages include Draconic, Dwarven, Giant, and Orc.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Bakemono can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Light Blindness: Abrupt exposure to bright light blinds bakemono for 1 round; on subsequent rounds, they are dazzled as long as they remain in the brightly lit area.
Resilient Digestion: Bakemono gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against poison, ingested hazards, and consumed toxins.
Offense and Skill Racial Traits
Metal-Crushing Bite (Ex): A bakemono possesses a primary bite attack dealing 1d4 points of damage. This bite deals full damage against objects and constructs, ignoring 5 points of object hardness. Against undead creatures, the bite deals an additional 1d4 points of damage.
Metalcraft: Bakemono receive a +2 racial bonus on Craft checks involving metallurgy, armor, weapons, and mechanical devices.
Ore Sense (Ex): A bakemono can detect the presence and approximate direction of unrefined precious metals and worked metal items within 30 feet, as if utilizing the scent ability.
